# Loading in OpenCode

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lumitive/lumi-style ~/src/lumi-style
ln -s ~/src/lumi-style ~/.config/opencode/skills/lumi-style
# or ~/.agents/skills/lumi-style
# or ~/.claude/skills/lumi-style
```

Invoke: say "in LUMI style…".

The skill reads `references/` and `tokens/` on demand — no need to attach them manually.

**Symlink rather than copy.** An installed copy silently stranded at 0.1.334 while the repo reached 0.1.337, and a deck was built against three versions of superseded rules. A symlink cannot go stale.

Project-level equivalents are `.opencode/skills/`, `.agents/skills/` and `.claude/skills/`, searched upward from the working directory to the git worktree root.

Vendor documentation: https://opencode.ai/docs/skills/
